name: amidophosphoribosyltransferase reaction
description: PRPP to 5-phosphoribosylamine; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: phosphoribosylamine--glycine ligase reaction
description: Formation of phosphoribosylglycinamide.

name: GAR transformylase reaction
description: Folate-dependent formation of phosphoribosyl-N-formylglycinamide.

name: GAR formyltransferase 2 reaction
description: Formate- and ATP-dependent alternative formation of phosphoribosyl-N-formylglycinamide.

name: FGAM synthase reaction
description: Formation of phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine.

name: AIR synthetase reaction
description: Cyclization to phosphoribosylaminoimidazole.

name: AIR carboxylase reaction
description: Direct AIR to CAIR conversion; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: N5-CAIR synthetase reaction
description: ATP-dependent formation of N5-carboxyaminoimidazole ribonucleotide.

name: N5-CAIR mutase reaction
description: Conversion of N5-carboxyaminoimidazole ribonucleotide to CAIR.

name: SAICAR synthetase reaction
description: Formation of succinylaminoimidazolecarboxamide ribotide.

name: SAICAR lyase reaction
description: Formation of AICAR and fumarate.

name: AICAR transformylase reaction
description: Folate-dependent formation of FAICAR.

name: FAICAR synthetase reaction
description: Formate- and ATP-dependent alternative formation of FAICAR.

name: IMP cyclohydrolase reaction
description: FAICAR to IMP ring closure; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: adenylosuccinate synthase reaction
description: Formation of adenylosuccinate from IMP.

name: adenylosuccinate lyase reaction
description: Formation of AMP and fumarate from adenylosuccinate.

name: IMP dehydrogenase reaction
description: NAD-dependent oxidation of IMP to XMP, committing the guanylate branch.

name: GMP synthase reaction
description: Glutamine-dependent amination of XMP to GMP.

name: carbamoyl-phosphate synthase reaction
description: Glutamine-dependent formation of carbamoyl phosphate.

name: aspartate carbamoyltransferase reaction
description: Formation of N-carbamoyl-L-aspartate from carbamoyl phosphate and L-aspartate.

name: dihydroorotase reaction
description: Cyclization to (S)-dihydroorotate; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: fumarate-dependent dihydroorotate dehydrogenase reaction
description: Oxidation of (S)-dihydroorotate to orotate using fumarate.

name: quinone-dependent dihydroorotate dehydrogenase reaction
description: Oxidation of (S)-dihydroorotate to orotate using a quinone.

name: NAD-dependent dihydroorotate dehydrogenase reaction
description: Oxidation of (S)-dihydroorotate to orotate using NAD(+).

name: orotate phosphoribosyltransferase reaction
description: Formation of orotidine 5'-phosphate from orotate and PRPP; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: orotidine 5'-phosphate decarboxylase reaction
description: Formation of UMP from orotidine 5'-phosphate.

name: CTP synthase reaction
description: Glutamine-dependent amination of UTP to CTP.

name: 3-phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase reaction
description: NAD-dependent oxidation of 3-phosphoglycerate to 3-phosphooxypyruvate, the committing step of phosphorylated serine biosynthesis.

name: phosphoserine aminotransferase reaction
description: Glutamate-dependent transamination forming O-phospho-L-serine; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: phosphoserine phosphatase reaction
description: Hydrolysis of O-phospho-L-serine to L-serine.

name: serine hydroxymethyltransferase reaction
description: Folate-dependent interconversion of serine and glycine; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation to form glycine.

name: aspartate kinase reaction
description: ATP-dependent phosphorylation of L-aspartate, the committing step of the aspartate amino acid family.

name: aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase reaction
description: NADPH-dependent reduction of 4-phospho-L-aspartate to the semialdehyde; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: homoserine dehydrogenase reaction (NAD)
description: NAD-dependent reduction of L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde to L-homoserine; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: homoserine dehydrogenase reaction (NADP)
description: NADP-dependent reduction of L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde to L-homoserine; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: homoserine kinase reaction
description: ATP-dependent phosphorylation of L-homoserine to O-phospho-L-homoserine.

name: threonine synthase reaction
description: Conversion of O-phospho-L-homoserine to L-threonine.

name: homoserine O-succinyltransferase reaction
description: Succinyl-CoA-dependent activation of L-homoserine.

name: homoserine O-acetyltransferase reaction
description: Acetyl-CoA-dependent activation of L-homoserine.

name: cystathionine gamma-synthase reaction (O-succinylhomoserine)
description: Cysteine-dependent formation of L,L-cystathionine from O-succinyl-L-homoserine.

name: cystathionine gamma-synthase reaction (O-acetylhomoserine)
description: Cysteine-dependent formation of L,L-cystathionine from O-acetyl-L-homoserine.

name: plant cystathionine gamma-synthase reaction
description: Cysteine-dependent formation of L,L-cystathionine from O-phospho-L-homoserine.

name: cystathionine beta-lyase reaction
description: Cleavage of L,L-cystathionine to L-homocysteine and pyruvate.

name: O-succinylhomoserine sulfhydrylase reaction
description: Direct incorporation of inorganic sulfide into O-succinyl-L-homoserine to give L-homocysteine.

name: O-acetylhomoserine sulfhydrylase reaction
description: Direct incorporation of inorganic sulfide into O-acetyl-L-homoserine to give L-homocysteine.

name: cobalamin-dependent methionine synthase reaction
description: Methyl transfer from 5-methyltetrahydrofolate to L-homocysteine.

name: cobalamin-independent methionine synthase reaction
description: Methyl transfer from 5-methyltetrahydropteroyltriglutamate to L-homocysteine.

name: serine O-acetyltransferase reaction
description: Acetyl-CoA-dependent activation of L-serine to O-acetyl-L-serine.

name: cysteine synthase reaction
description: Incorporation of inorganic sulfide into O-acetyl-L-serine to give L-cysteine.

name: cystathionine beta-synthase reaction
description: Condensation of L-serine with L-homocysteine to give L,L-cystathionine.

name: cystathionine beta-synthase reaction (O-acetyl-L-serine)
description: Condensation of O-acetyl-L-serine with L-homocysteine to give L,L-cystathionine.

name: cystathionine gamma-lyase reaction
description: Cleavage of L,L-cystathionine to L-cysteine and 2-oxobutanoate.

name: xylose isomerase reaction
description: alpha-D-xylose = alpha-D-xylulofuranose.

name: xylulokinase reaction
description: D-xylulose + ATP = D-xylulose 5-phosphate + ADP.

name: L-arabinose isomerase reaction
description: beta-L-arabinopyranose = L-ribulose.

name: L-ribulokinase reaction
description: L-ribulose + ATP = L-ribulose 5-phosphate + ADP.

name: L-ribulose-5-phosphate 4-epimerase reaction
description: L-ribulose 5-phosphate = D-xylulose 5-phosphate.

name: L-fucose isomerase reaction
description: L-fucose = L-fuculose.

name: L-fuculokinase reaction
description: L-fuculose + ATP = L-fuculose 1-phosphate + ADP.

name: L-fuculose-1-phosphate aldolase reaction
description: L-fuculose 1-phosphate = (S)-lactaldehyde + dihydroxyacetone phosphate.

name: L-rhamnose isomerase reaction
description: L-rhamnopyranose = L-rhamnulose.

name: rhamnulokinase reaction
description: L-rhamnulose + ATP = L-rhamnulose 1-phosphate + ADP.

name: rhamnulose-1-phosphate aldolase reaction
description: L-rhamnulose 1-phosphate = (S)-lactaldehyde + dihydroxyacetone phosphate.

name: aldose 1-epimerase reaction on D-galactose
description: alpha-D-galactose = beta-D-galactose; used in reverse for catabolism.

name: galactokinase reaction
description: alpha-D-galactose + ATP = alpha-D-galactose 1-phosphate + ADP.

name: galactose-1-phosphate uridylyltransferase reaction
description: alpha-D-galactose 1-phosphate + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate + UDP-alpha-D-galactose.

name: UDP-glucose 4-epimerase reaction
description: UDP-alpha-D-glucose = UDP-alpha-D-galactose; used in reverse to regenerate UDP-glucose.

name: N-acetylglucosamine kinase reaction
description: N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + ATP = N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate + ADP.

name: N-acetylglucosamine-6-phosphate deacetylase reaction
description: N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate + H2O = D-glucosamine 6-phosphate + acetate.

name: glucosamine-6-phosphate deaminase reaction
description: alpha-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate + H2O = beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate + ammonium.

name: N-acetylneuraminate lyase reaction
description: aceneuramate = aldehydo-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine + pyruvate.

name: N-acetylmannosamine kinase reaction
description: aldehydo-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine + ATP = aldehydo-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine 6-phosphate + ADP.

name: N-acetylmannosamine-6-phosphate 2-epimerase reaction
description: N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate = aldehydo-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine 6-phosphate; used in reverse for catabolism.

name: glucuronate isomerase reaction on D-galacturonate
description: aldehydo-D-galacturonate = keto-D-tagaturonate.

name: tagaturonate reductase reaction
description: D-altronate + NAD+ = keto-D-tagaturonate + NADH; used in reverse for catabolism.

name: altronate dehydratase reaction
description: D-altronate = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate + H2O.

name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxygluconokinase reaction
description: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate + ATP = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phospho-D-gluconate + ADP.

name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-phosphogluconate aldolase reaction
description: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phospho-D-gluconate = D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + pyruvate.

name: glucuronate isomerase reaction on D-glucuronate
description: D-glucuronate = D-fructuronate.

name: fructuronate reductase reaction
description: D-mannonate + NAD+ = keto-D-fructuronate + NADH; used in reverse for catabolism.

name: mannonate dehydratase reaction
description: D-mannonate = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate + H2O.

name: ABC-type D-xylose import reaction
description: D-xylose(out) + ATP + H2O = D-xylose(in) + ADP + phosphate + H(+).

name: ABC-type L-arabinose import reaction
description: L-arabinose(out) + ATP + H2O = L-arabinose(in) + ADP + phosphate + H(+).

name: alpha-L-arabinofuranosidase reaction
description: Hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing alpha-L-arabinofuranosyl residues from arabinoxylan.

name: endo-1,4-beta-xylanase reaction
description: Endohydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-xylosidic linkages in xylan.

name: xylan 1,4-beta-xylosidase reaction
description: Hydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-xylans to remove successive D-xylose residues from the non-reducing end.

name: alpha-amylase reaction
description: Endohydrolysis of (1->4)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in starch.

name: pullulanase reaction
description: Hydrolysis of (1->6)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in pullulan and amylopectin.

name: alpha-glucosidase reaction
description: Hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing (1->4)-linked alpha-D-glucose residues, releasing alpha-D-glucose.

name: acetylxylan esterase reaction
description: Hydrolysis of acetyl groups from the xylan backbone, exposing it to endo-acting xylanases.

name: microbial collagenase reaction
description: Digestion of native collagen in the triple-helical region at Gly bonds. Rhea covers collagen hydroxylation, glycosylation and crosslinking but contains no proteolytic cleavage of the helix, so this reaction carries no master and is identified by its EC cross-reference.

name: pyruvate dehydrogenase complex reaction
description: pyruvate + NAD(+) + CoA = acetyl-CoA + CO2 + NADH.

name: pyruvate:ferredoxin oxidoreductase reaction
description: 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + pyruvate + CoA = 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + acetyl-CoA + CO2 + H(+). Oxygen-sensitive.

name: pyruvate formate-lyase reaction
description: formate + acetyl-CoA = pyruvate + CoA; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: phosphate acetyltransferase reaction
description: acetyl-CoA + phosphate = acetyl phosphate + CoA.

name: acetate kinase reaction
description: acetate + ATP = acetyl phosphate + ADP; used in reverse for acetate formation.

name: acetyl-CoA C-acetyltransferase reaction
description: 2 acetyl-CoA = acetoacetyl-CoA + CoA.

name: 3-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA dehydrogenase reaction
description: (3S)-3-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA + NADP(+) = acetoacetyl-CoA + NADPH + H(+); used in reverse. The NAD-dependent RHEA:30799 is the same enzyme's alternative cofactor mode, is annotated to the same orthologue, and is not treated as a genomically distinct route.

name: 3-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA dehydratase reaction
description: (3S)-3-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA = (2E)-butenoyl-CoA + H2O. The butanoyl-specific reaction is used rather than the generic short-chain master RHEA:52664, because a generic acyl chain length would not fix the product of the route.

name: butanoyl-CoA dehydrogenase reaction
description: butanoyl-CoA + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] + H(+) = (2E)-butenoyl-CoA + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein]; used in reverse.

name: butanoyl-CoA:acetate CoA-transferase reaction
description: butanoate + acetyl-CoA = butanoyl-CoA + acetate; used in reverse. The butanoate-specific reaction is used rather than the generic EC 2.8.3.8 master RHEA:13381, whose acyl-CoA is unspecified.

name: lactaldehyde reductase reaction
description: (S)-propane-1,2-diol + NAD(+) = (S)-lactaldehyde + NADH + H(+); used in reverse.

name: propanediol dehydratase reaction
description: propane-1,2-diol = propanal + H2O. Adenosylcobalamin-dependent, and stereochemically unspecified in Rhea while the declared boundary is the (S) diol.

name: propionaldehyde dehydrogenase reaction
description: propanal + NAD(+) + CoA = propanoyl-CoA + NADH + H(+).

name: phosphate propanoyltransferase reaction
description: propanoyl-CoA + phosphate = propanoyl phosphate + CoA.

name: propionate kinase reaction
description: propanoate + ATP = propanoyl phosphate + ADP; used in reverse for propionate formation.

name: propionate CoA-transferase reaction on lactate
description: (R)-lactate + propanoyl-CoA = (R)-lactoyl-CoA + propanoate. Rhea's EC 2.8.3.1 master RHEA:23520 covers only the propanoate/acetyl-CoA transfer, so the lactate-accepting transfer of the acrylate pathway carries no master and is identified by KEGG R01449, which records it in the opposite direction, and by its EC cross-reference.

name: lactoyl-CoA dehydratase reaction
description: (R)-lactoyl-CoA = acryloyl-CoA + H2O.

name: acryloyl-CoA reductase reaction
description: propanoyl-CoA + NAD(+) = acryloyl-CoA + NADH + H(+); used in reverse.

name: L-lactate dehydrogenase reaction
description: (S)-lactate + NAD(+) = pyruvate + NADH + H(+); used in reverse for lactate formation.

name: lactate racemase reaction
description: (S)-lactate = (R)-lactate.

name: malolactic enzyme reaction
description: (S)-malate + H(+) = (S)-lactate + CO2. The decarboxylation makes the step irreversible, which is why malate may be a curated boundary while the reversible citric acid cycle reactions may not.

name: citrate lyase reaction
description: citrate = oxaloacetate + acetate. Rhea also splits the same chemistry into citryl-CoA half-reactions under EC 2.8.3.10 (RHEA:19405) and EC 4.1.3.34 (RHEA:20812); the EC 4.1.3.6 master is curated instead, so that one three-subunit enzyme is one curated step rather than two.

name: oxaloacetate decarboxylase reaction
description: oxaloacetate + H(+) = pyruvate + CO2.

name: acetaldehyde dehydrogenase (acetylating) reaction
description: acetaldehyde + NAD(+) + CoA = acetyl-CoA + NADH + H(+); used in reverse for ethanol formation.

name: alcohol dehydrogenase reaction on ethanol
description: ethanol + NAD(+) = acetaldehyde + NADH + H(+); used in reverse for ethanol formation. Curated at this specificity rather than at the generic primary-alcohol parent RHEA:10736, which would let the route claim a chain length its chemistry does not fix.

name: acetolactate synthase reaction
description: 2 pyruvate + H(+) = (2S)-2-acetolactate + CO2.

name: acetolactate decarboxylase reaction
description: (2S)-2-acetolactate + H(+) = (R)-acetoin + CO2.

name: GTP cyclohydrolase II reaction
description: GTP + 4 H2O = 2,5-diamino-6-hydroxy-4-(5-phosphoribosylamino)-pyrimidine + formate + 2 phosphate + 3 H(+).

name: diaminohydroxyphosphoribosylaminopyrimidine deaminase reaction
description: 2,5-diamino-6-hydroxy-4-(5-phosphoribosylamino)-pyrimidine + H2O + H(+) = 5-amino-6-(5-phospho-D-ribosylamino)uracil + NH4(+).

name: 5-amino-6-(5-phosphoribosylamino)uracil reductase reaction
description: 5-amino-6-(5-phospho-D-ribitylamino)uracil + NADP(+) = 5-amino-6-(5-phospho-D-ribosylamino)uracil + NADPH + H(+).

name: 5-amino-6-(5-phospho-D-ribitylamino)uracil phosphatase reaction
description: 5-amino-6-(5-phospho-D-ribitylamino)uracil + H2O = 5-amino-6-(D-ribitylamino)uracil + phosphate.

name: 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone 4-phosphate synthase reaction
description: D-ribulose 5-phosphate = (2S)-2-hydroxy-3-oxobutyl phosphate + formate + H(+).

name: 6,7-dimethyl-8-ribityllumazine synthase reaction
description: (2S)-2-hydroxy-3-oxobutyl phosphate + 5-amino-6-(D-ribitylamino)uracil = 6,7-dimethyl-8-(1-D-ribityl)lumazine + phosphate + 2 H2O + H(+).

name: riboflavin synthase reaction
description: 2 6,7-dimethyl-8-(1-D-ribityl)lumazine + H(+) = 5-amino-6-(D-ribitylamino)uracil + riboflavin.

name: 4-amino-4-deoxychorismate synthase reaction
description: chorismate + L-glutamine = 4-amino-4-deoxychorismate + L-glutamate.

name: 4-amino-4-deoxychorismate lyase reaction
description: 4-amino-4-deoxychorismate = 4-aminobenzoate + pyruvate + H(+).

name: GTP cyclohydrolase I reaction
description: GTP + H2O = 7,8-dihydroneopterin 3'-triphosphate + formate + H(+).

name: dihydroneopterin triphosphate diphosphatase reaction
description: 7,8-dihydroneopterin 3'-triphosphate + H2O = 7,8-dihydroneopterin 3'-phosphate + diphosphate + H(+).

name: dihydroneopterin aldolase reaction
description: 7,8-dihydroneopterin = 6-hydroxymethyl-7,8-dihydropterin + glycolaldehyde.

name: 2-amino-4-hydroxy-6-hydroxymethyldihydropteridine diphosphokinase reaction
description: 6-hydroxymethyl-7,8-dihydropterin + ATP = (7,8-dihydropterin-6-yl)methyl diphosphate + AMP + H(+).

name: dihydropteroate synthase reaction
description: (7,8-dihydropterin-6-yl)methyl diphosphate + 4-aminobenzoate = 7,8-dihydropteroate + diphosphate.

name: dihydrofolate synthase reaction
description: 7,8-dihydropteroate + L-glutamate + ATP = 7,8-dihydrofolate + ADP + phosphate + H(+).

name: dihydrofolate reductase reaction
description: (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + NADP(+) = 7,8-dihydrofolate + NADPH + H(+).

name: phosphomethylpyrimidine synthase reaction
description: 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)imidazole + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 4-amino-2-methyl-5-(phosphooxymethyl)pyrimidine + CO + 5'-deoxyadenosine + formate + L-methionine + 3 H(+).

name: phosphomethylpyrimidine kinase reaction
description: 4-amino-2-methyl-5-(phosphooxymethyl)pyrimidine + ATP = 4-amino-2-methyl-5-(diphosphooxymethyl)pyrimidine + ADP.

name: 2-iminoacetate synthase reaction
description: L-tyrosine + S-adenosyl-L-methionine + NADPH = 2-iminoacetate + 4-methylphenol + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine + NADP(+).

name: thiazole synthase reaction
description: [ThiS sulfur-carrier protein]-C-terminal-Gly-aminoethanethioate + 2-iminoacetate + 1-deoxy-D-xylulose 5-phosphate = [ThiS sulfur-carrier protein]-C-terminal Gly-Gly + 2-[(2R,5Z)-2-carboxy-4-methylthiazol-5(2H)-ylidene]ethyl phosphate + 2 H2O + H(+).

name: glycine oxidase reaction
description: glycine + O2 = 2-iminoacetate + H2O2.

name: thiamine phosphate synthase reaction
description: 4-methyl-5-(2-phosphooxyethyl)-thiazole + 4-amino-2-methyl-5-(diphosphooxymethyl)pyrimidine + H(+) = thiamine phosphate + diphosphate.

name: hydroxymethylpyrimidine kinase reaction
description: 4-amino-5-hydroxymethyl-2-methylpyrimidine + ATP = 4-amino-2-methyl-5-(phosphooxymethyl)pyrimidine + ADP + H(+).

name: hydroxyethylthiazole kinase reaction
description: 5-(2-hydroxyethyl)-4-methylthiazole + ATP = 4-methyl-5-(2-phosphooxyethyl)-thiazole + ADP + H(+).

name: 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate hydroxymethyltransferase reaction
description: (6R)-5,10-methylene-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate + H2O = 2-dehydropantoate + (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate.

name: 2-dehydropantoate 2-reductase reaction
description: (R)-pantoate + NADP(+) = 2-dehydropantoate + NADPH + H(+).

name: aspartate 1-decarboxylase reaction
description: L-aspartate + H(+) = beta-alanine + CO2.

name: pantothenate synthetase reaction
description: (R)-pantoate + beta-alanine + ATP = (R)-pantothenate + AMP + diphosphate + H(+).

name: pyridoxal 5-phosphate synthase reaction
description: aldehydo-D-ribose 5-phosphate + D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + L-glutamine = pyridoxal 5'-phosphate + L-glutamate + phosphate + 3 H2O + H(+).

name: D-erythrose 4-phosphate dehydrogenase reaction
description: D-erythrose 4-phosphate + NAD(+) + H2O = 4-phospho-D-erythronate + NADH + 2 H(+).

name: erythronate-4-phosphate dehydrogenase reaction
description: 4-phospho-D-erythronate + NAD(+) = (R)-3-hydroxy-2-oxo-4-phosphooxybutanoate + NADH + H(+).

name: phosphohydroxythreonine transaminase reaction
description: 4-(phosphooxy)-L-threonine + 2-oxoglutarate = (R)-3-hydroxy-2-oxo-4-phosphooxybutanoate + L-glutamate.

name: 4-hydroxythreonine-4-phosphate dehydrogenase reaction
description: 4-(phosphooxy)-L-threonine + NAD(+) = 3-amino-2-oxopropyl phosphate + CO2 + NADH.

name: pyridoxine 5-phosphate synthase reaction
description: 3-amino-2-oxopropyl phosphate + 1-deoxy-D-xylulose 5-phosphate = pyridoxine 5'-phosphate + phosphate + 2 H2O + H(+).

name: pyridoxine 5-phosphate oxidase reaction
description: pyridoxine 5'-phosphate + O2 = pyridoxal 5'-phosphate + H2O2.

name: 8-amino-7-oxononanoate synthase reaction
description: 6-carboxyhexanoyl-CoA + L-alanine + H(+) = (8S)-8-amino-7-oxononanoate + CO2 + CoA.

name: adenosylmethionine-8-amino-7-oxononanoate transaminase reaction
description: (8S)-8-amino-7-oxononanoate + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = S-adenosyl-4-methylsulfanyl-2-oxobutanoate + (7R,8S)-7,8-diammoniononanoate.

name: dethiobiotin synthetase reaction
description: (7R,8S)-7,8-diammoniononanoate + CO2 + ATP = (4R,5S)-dethiobiotin + ADP + phosphate + 3 H(+).

name: biotin synthase reaction
description: (4R,5S)-dethiobiotin + (sulfur carrier)-SH + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = (sulfur carrier)-H + biotin + 2 5'-deoxyadenosine + 2 L-methionine + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin].

name: lysine-8-amino-7-oxononanoate transaminase reaction
description: (8S)-8-amino-7-oxononanoate + L-lysine = (7R,8S)-7,8-diammoniononanoate + (S)-2-amino-6-oxohexanoate.

name: L-aspartate oxidase reaction
description: L-aspartate + O2 = iminosuccinate + H2O2.

name: quinolinate synthase reaction
description: iminosuccinate + dihydroxyacetone phosphate = quinolinate + phosphate + 2 H2O + H(+).

name: aspartate dehydrogenase reaction
description: L-aspartate + NAD(+) = iminosuccinate + NADH + H(+).

name: nicotinate-nucleotide pyrophosphorylase reaction
description: nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide + CO2 + diphosphate = quinolinate + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + 2 H(+).

name: nicotinate-nucleotide adenylyltransferase reaction
description: nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide + ATP + H(+) = deamido-NAD(+) + diphosphate.

name: NAD synthetase (ammonia) reaction
description: deamido-NAD(+) + NH4(+) + ATP = AMP + diphosphate + NAD(+) + H(+).

name: NAD synthetase (glutamine-hydrolysing) reaction
description: deamido-NAD(+) + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O = L-glutamate + AMP + diphosphate + NAD(+) + H(+).

name: nicotinate phosphoribosyltransferase reaction
description: 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + nicotinate + ATP + H2O = nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide + ADP + phosphate + diphosphate.

name: uroporphyrinogen III C-methyltransferase reaction
description: uroporphyrinogen III + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = precorrin-2 + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+).

name: precorrin-2 dehydrogenase reaction
description: precorrin-2 + NAD(+) = sirohydrochlorin + NADH + 2 H(+).

name: sirohydrochlorin cobaltochelatase reaction
description: Co-sirohydrochlorin + 2 H(+) = sirohydrochlorin + Co(2+).

name: cobalt-factor II C20-methyltransferase reaction
description: Co-precorrin-2 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = Co-precorrin-3 + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+).

name: cobalt-factor III methyltransferase reaction
description: Co(II)-factor III + AH2 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = Co-precorrin-4 + A + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: cobalt-precorrin-4 C11-methyltransferase reaction
description: Co-precorrin-4 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = Co-precorrin-5A + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+).

name: cobalt-precorrin-5A hydrolase reaction
description: Co-precorrin-5A + H2O = Co-precorrin-5B + acetaldehyde + H(+).

name: cobalt-precorrin-5B C1-methyltransferase reaction
description: Co-precorrin-5B + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = Co-precorrin-6A + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: cobalt-precorrin-6A reductase reaction
description: Co-precorrin-6B + NAD(+) = Co-precorrin-6A + NADH + H(+).

name: cobalt-precorrin-6B C15-methyltransferase reaction
description: Co-precorrin-6B + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = Co-precorrin-7 + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + CO2.

name: cobalt-precorrin-7 C5-methyltransferase reaction
description: Co-precorrin-7 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = Co-precorrin-8X + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+).

name: cobalt-precorrin-8 methylmutase reaction
description: Co-precorrin-8X = cob(II)yrinate.

name: cobyrinate a,c-diamide synthase reaction
description: cob(II)yrinate + 2 L-glutamine + 2 ATP + 2 H2O = cob(II)yrinate a,c diamide + 2 L-glutamate + 2 ADP + 2 phosphate + 2 H(+).

name: precorrin-2 C20-methyltransferase reaction
description: precorrin-2 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = precorrin-3A + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+).

name: precorrin-3B synthase reaction
description: precorrin-3A + NADH + O2 + 2 H(+) = precorrin-3B + NAD(+) + H2O.

name: precorrin-3B C17-methyltransferase reaction
description: precorrin-3B + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = precorrin-4 + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + 3 H(+).

name: precorrin-4 C11-methyltransferase reaction
description: precorrin-4 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = precorrin-5 + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: precorrin-6A synthase reaction
description: precorrin-5 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine + H2O = precorrin-6A + acetate + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + 2 H(+).

name: precorrin-6A reductase reaction
description: precorrin-6B + NADP(+) = precorrin-6A + NADPH + 2 H(+).

name: precorrin-6B C5,C15-methyltransferase reaction
description: precorrin-6B + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = precorrin-8X + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + CO2 + 3 H(+).

name: precorrin-8X methylmutase reaction
description: precorrin-8X + 3 H(+) = hydrogenobyrinate.

name: hydrogenobyrinate a,c-diamide synthase reaction
description: hydrogenobyrinate + 2 L-glutamine + 2 ATP + 2 H2O = hydrogenobyrinate a,c-diamide + 2 L-glutamate + 2 ADP + 2 phosphate + 2 H(+).

name: cobaltochelatase CobNST reaction
description: hydrogenobyrinate a,c-diamide + Co(2+) + ATP + H2O = cob(II)yrinate a,c diamide + ADP + phosphate + 5 H(+).

name: cob(I)yrinate a,c-diamide adenosyltransferase reaction
description: 2 cob(II)yrinate a,c diamide + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein] + 2 ATP = 2 adenosylcob(III)yrinate a,c-diamide + 2 triphosphate + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] + 3 H(+).

name: adenosylcobyric acid synthase reaction
description: adenosylcob(III)yrinate a,c-diamide + 4 L-glutamine + 4 ATP + 4 H2O = adenosylcob(III)yrate + 4 L-glutamate + 4 ADP + 4 phosphate + 4 H(+).

name: adenosylcobinamide-phosphate synthase reaction
description: (R)-1-aminopropan-2-yl phosphate + adenosylcob(III)yrate + ATP = adenosylcob(III)inamide phosphate + ADP + phosphate + H(+).

name: adenosylcobinamide-phosphate guanylyltransferase reaction
description: adenosylcob(III)inamide phosphate + GTP + H(+) = adenosylcob(III)inamide-GDP + diphosphate.

name: nicotinate-nucleotide dimethylbenzimidazole phosphoribosyltransferase reaction
description: 5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole + nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide = alpha-ribazole 5'-phosphate + nicotinate + H(+).

name: alpha-ribazole phosphatase reaction
description: alpha-ribazole 5'-phosphate + H2O = alpha-ribazole + phosphate.

name: adenosylcobinamide-GDP ribazoletransferase reaction
description: alpha-ribazole + adenosylcob(III)inamide-GDP = adenosylcob(III)alamin + GMP + H(+).

name: 5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole synthase reaction
description: FMNH2 + O2 = dialurate + 5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole + D-erythrose 4-phosphate + H(+).

name: isochorismate synthase reaction
description: chorismate = isochorismate.

name: SEPHCHC synthase reaction
description: isochorismate + 2-oxoglutarate + H(+) = 5-enolpyruvoyl-6-hydroxy-2-succinyl-cyclohex-3-ene-1-carboxylate + CO2.

name: SHCHC synthase reaction
description: 5-enolpyruvoyl-6-hydroxy-2-succinyl-cyclohex-3-ene-1-carboxylate = (1R,6R)-6-hydroxy-2-succinyl-cyclohexa-2,4-diene-1-carboxylate + pyruvate.

name: o-succinylbenzoate synthase reaction
description: (1R,6R)-6-hydroxy-2-succinyl-cyclohexa-2,4-diene-1-carboxylate = 2-succinylbenzoate + H2O.

name: o-succinylbenzoate-CoA ligase reaction
description: 2-succinylbenzoate + ATP + CoA = 2-succinylbenzoyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate.

name: 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoyl-CoA synthase reaction
description: 2-succinylbenzoyl-CoA + H(+) = 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoyl-CoA + H2O.

name: 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoyl-CoA hydrolase reaction
description: 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoyl-CoA + H2O = 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoate + CoA + H(+).

name: 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoate polyprenyltransferase reaction
description: an all-trans-polyprenyl diphosphate + 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoate + H(+) = a 2-demethylmenaquinol + CO2 + diphosphate.

name: demethylmenaquinol methyltransferase reaction
description: a 2-demethylmenaquinol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a menaquinol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+).

name: chorismate dehydratase reaction
description: chorismate = 3-[(1-carboxyvinyl)-oxy]benzoate + H2O.

name: aminodeoxyfutalosine synthase reaction
description: 3-[(1-carboxyvinyl)-oxy]benzoate + S-adenosyl-L-methionine + H2O = 6-amino-6-deoxyfutalosine + hydrogencarbonate + L-methionine + H(+).

name: aminodeoxyfutalosine deaminase reaction
description: 6-amino-6-deoxyfutalosine + H2O + H(+) = futalosine + NH4(+).

name: futalosine hydrolase reaction
description: futalosine + H2O = dehypoxanthine futalosine + hypoxanthine.

name: cyclic dehypoxanthinyl futalosine synthase reaction
description: dehypoxanthine futalosine + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = cyclic dehypoxanthinylfutalosinate + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine + H(+).

name: 1,4-dihydroxy-6-naphthoate synthase reaction
description: cyclic dehypoxanthinylfutalosinate = 1,4-dihydroxy-6-naphthoate + dihydroxyacetone.

name: citrate synthase reaction
description: oxaloacetate + acetyl-CoA + H2O = citrate + CoA + H(+). Both the si- and the Re-citrate synthases catalyse this one reaction, which is why they are two enzyme systems and not two reactions.

name: aconitate hydratase reaction
description: citrate = D-threo-isocitrate. Rhea records the overall isomerisation, so cis-aconitate is not a separate curated step.

name: isocitrate dehydrogenase reaction, NADP-dependent
description: D-threo-isocitrate + NADP(+) = 2-oxoglutarate + CO2 + NADPH. The decarboxylation is irreversible, which is what licenses the direction of the GIFT that uses it.

name: isocitrate dehydrogenase reaction, NAD-dependent
description: D-threo-isocitrate + NAD(+) = 2-oxoglutarate + CO2 + NADH.

name: 2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase complex reaction
description: 2-oxoglutarate + NAD(+) + CoA = succinyl-CoA + CO2 + NADH. The overall reaction of the multienzyme complex, not the E1 half-reaction.

name: 2-oxoglutarate:ferredoxin oxidoreductase reaction
description: 2 oxidized ferredoxin + 2-oxoglutarate + CoA = succinyl-CoA + 2 reduced ferredoxin + CO2 + H(+). Genuinely reversible; this is the reductive citric acid cycle enzyme.

name: succinyl-CoA synthetase reaction
description: succinate + ATP + CoA = succinyl-CoA + ADP + phosphate. Rhea writes the succinyl-CoA-forming direction, so a route travelling towards succinate records this step as reverse.

name: 2-oxoglutarate decarboxylase reaction
description: 2-oxoglutarate + H(+) = succinate semialdehyde + CO2. The first step of the actinobacterial and cyanobacterial bypass of the dehydrogenase complex.

name: succinate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase reaction, NAD-dependent
description: succinate semialdehyde + NAD(+) + H2O = succinate + NADH + 2 H(+).

name: succinate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase reaction, NADP-dependent
description: succinate semialdehyde + NADP(+) + H2O = succinate + NADPH + 2 H(+). Curated separately from the NAD form because they are distinct Rhea masters with partly distinct markers.

name: succinate dehydrogenase and fumarate reductase reaction
description: a quinone + succinate = fumarate + a quinol. The generic quinone form is curated deliberately: the ubiquinone, menaquinone and rhodoquinone reactions are separate Rhea masters and no genomic marker distinguishes which one an enzyme uses.

name: fumarate hydratase reaction
description: (S)-malate = fumarate + H2O. Rhea writes the fumarate-forming direction, so a route travelling from fumarate to malate records this step as reverse.

name: malate dehydrogenase reaction
description: (S)-malate + NAD(+) = oxaloacetate + NADH + H(+). Near equilibrium and reversible in vivo.

name: malate:quinone oxidoreductase reaction
description: (S)-malate + a quinone = a quinol + oxaloacetate. Effectively unidirectional towards oxaloacetate, and the only step of the fumarate/oxaloacetate arm that is.

name: 3-deoxy-7-phosphoheptulonate synthase reaction
description: D-erythrose 4-phosphate + phosphoenolpyruvate + H2O = 7-phospho-2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-arabino-heptonate + phosphate.

name: 3-dehydroquinate synthase reaction
description: 7-phospho-2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-arabino-heptonate = 3-dehydroquinate + phosphate.

name: 3-dehydroquinate dehydratase reaction
description: 3-dehydroquinate = 3-dehydroshikimate + H2O.

name: shikimate dehydrogenase reaction
description: shikimate + NADP(+) = 3-dehydroshikimate + NADPH + H(+); used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation, because the biosynthetic direction reduces 3-dehydroshikimate.

name: shikimate kinase reaction
description: shikimate + ATP = 3-phosphoshikimate + ADP + H(+).

name: 3-phosphoshikimate 1-carboxyvinyltransferase reaction
description: 3-phosphoshikimate + phosphoenolpyruvate = 5-O-(1-carboxyvinyl)-3-phosphoshikimate + phosphate. The second of the two phosphoenolpyruvate inputs of the pathway.

name: chorismate synthase reaction
description: 5-O-(1-carboxyvinyl)-3-phosphoshikimate = chorismate + phosphate.

name: isochorismate pyruvate lyase reaction
description: isochorismate = salicylate + pyruvate.

name: tryptophan 2-monooxygenase reaction
description: L-tryptophan + O2 = indole-3-acetamide + CO2 + H2O.

name: indole-3-acetamide hydrolase reaction
description: indole-3-acetamide + H2O = (indol-3-yl)acetate + NH4(+).

name: urate oxidase reaction
description: urate + O2 + H2O = 5-hydroxyisourate + H2O2.

name: FAD-dependent urate hydroxylase reaction
description: urate + NADH + O2 + H(+) = 5-hydroxyisourate + NAD(+) + H2O.

name: 5-hydroxyisourate hydrolase reaction
description: 5-hydroxyisourate + H2O = 5-hydroxy-2-oxo-4-ureido-2,5-dihydro-1H-imidazole-5-carboxylate + H(+).

name: OHCU decarboxylase reaction
description: 5-hydroxy-2-oxo-4-ureido-2,5-dihydro-1H-imidazole-5-carboxylate + H(+) = (S)-allantoin + CO2.

name: allantoinase reaction
description: (S)-allantoin + H2O = allantoate + H(+).

name: allantoicase reaction
description: allantoate + H2O = (S)-ureidoglycolate + urea.

name: allantoate deiminase reaction
description: allantoate + H2O + 2 H(+) = (S)-2-ureidoglycine + NH4(+) + CO2.

name: (S)-ureidoglycine aminohydrolase reaction
description: (S)-2-ureidoglycine + H2O = (S)-ureidoglycolate + NH4(+).

name: ureidoglycolate lyase reaction
description: (S)-ureidoglycolate = urea + glyoxylate.

name: urease reaction
description: urea + 2 H2O + H(+) = hydrogencarbonate + 2 NH4(+).

name: assimilatory nitrate reductase reaction
description: nitrite + A + H2O = nitrate + AH2; used in reverse for assimilation. The acceptor is unspecified in the Rhea record because the assimilatory nitrate reductase EC was deleted; the marker is nonetheless specific to the assimilatory enzyme.

name: ferredoxin-nitrate reductase reaction
description: nitrite + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + H2O = nitrate + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 H(+); used in reverse for assimilation.

name: ferredoxin-nitrite reductase reaction
description: 6 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + NH4(+) + 2 H2O = nitrite + 6 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 8 H(+); used in reverse for assimilation.

name: nitrite reductase (NADH) reaction
description: NH4(+) + 3 NAD(+) + 2 H2O = nitrite + 3 NADH + 5 H(+); used in reverse for assimilation.

name: glycine betaine monooxygenase reaction
description: glycine betaine + NADH + O2 + H(+) = N,N-dimethylglycine + formaldehyde + NAD(+) + H2O.

name: N,N-dimethylglycine dehydrogenase (ferredoxin) reaction
description: oxidized 2[4Fe-4S]-[ferredoxin] + N,N-dimethylglycine + H2O = reduced 2[4Fe-4S]-[ferredoxin] + sarcosine + formaldehyde + 2 H(+).

name: N,N-dimethylglycine dehydrogenase (ETF) reaction
description: (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolyl-(gamma-L-Glu)(n) + N,N-dimethylglycine + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] + H(+) = (6R)-5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolyl-(gamma-L-Glu)(n) + sarcosine + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein].

name: dimethylglycine oxidase reaction
description: N,N-dimethylglycine + O2 + H2O = sarcosine + formaldehyde + H2O2.

name: sarcosine oxidase reaction
description: sarcosine + O2 + H2O = formaldehyde + glycine + H2O2.

name: sarcosine dehydrogenase (ferredoxin) reaction
description: oxidized 2[4Fe-4S]-[ferredoxin] + sarcosine + H2O = reduced 2[4Fe-4S]-[ferredoxin] + formaldehyde + glycine + 2 H(+).

name: creatinine amidohydrolase reaction
description: creatinine + H2O = creatine.

name: creatinase reaction
description: creatine + H2O = sarcosine + urea.

name: carnitine monooxygenase reaction
description: (R)-carnitine + NADH + O2 + H(+) = (3R)-3-hydroxy-4-oxobutanoate + trimethylamine + NAD(+) + H2O. Rhea also carries the NADPH form as RHEA:55368.

name: carnitine 3-dehydrogenase reaction
description: carnitine + NAD(+) = 3-dehydrocarnitine + NADH + H(+).

name: 3-dehydrocarnitine:acetyl-CoA transferase reaction
description: 3-dehydrocarnitine + acetyl-CoA = N,N,N-trimethylglycyl-CoA + acetoacetate.

name: betainyl-CoA thioesterase reaction
description: N,N,N-trimethylglycyl-CoA + H2O = glycine betaine + CoA + H(+).

name: methylamine dehydrogenase reaction
description: 2 oxidized [amicyanin] + methylamine + H2O = 2 reduced [amicyanin] + formaldehyde + NH4(+) + 2 H(+).

name: taurine dioxygenase reaction
description: taurine + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = aminoacetaldehyde + sulfite + succinate + CO2 + H(+).

name: taurine-pyruvate aminotransferase reaction
description: taurine + pyruvate = sulfoacetaldehyde + L-alanine.

name: taurine dehydrogenase reaction
description: taurine + A + H2O = sulfoacetaldehyde + AH2 + NH4(+).

name: sulfoacetaldehyde acetyltransferase reaction
description: acetyl phosphate + sulfite + H(+) = sulfoacetaldehyde + phosphate; used in reverse for taurine catabolism.

name: ABC-type taurine import reaction
description: taurine(out) + ATP + H2O = taurine(in) + ADP + phosphate + H(+).

name: glutamine synthetase reaction
description: L-glutamate + NH4(+) + ATP = L-glutamine + ADP + phosphate + H(+).

name: glutamate synthase (NADPH) reaction
description: 2 L-glutamate + NADP(+) = L-glutamine + 2-oxoglutarate + NADPH + H(+); used in reverse for assimilation.

name: glutamate synthase (ferredoxin) reaction
description: 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 L-glutamate = L-glutamine + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2-oxoglutarate + 2 H(+); used in reverse for assimilation.

name: glutamate dehydrogenase (NADP+) reaction
description: L-glutamate + NADP(+) + H2O = 2-oxoglutarate + NH4(+) + NADPH + H(+); used in reverse for assimilation.

name: glutamate dehydrogenase (NAD+) reaction
description: L-glutamate + NAD(+) + H2O = 2-oxoglutarate + NH4(+) + NADH + H(+); used in reverse for assimilation.

name: benzoate 1,2-dioxygenase reaction
description: benzoate + NADH + O2 + H(+) = (1R,6S)-1,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,4-diene-1-carboxylate + NAD(+)

name: dihydroxycyclohexadiene carboxylate dehydrogenase reaction
description: (1R,6S)-1,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,4-diene-1-carboxylate + NAD(+) = catechol + CO2 + NADH

name: anthranilate 1,2-dioxygenase reaction
description: anthranilate + NADPH + O2 + 3 H(+) = catechol + NH4(+) + CO2 + NADP(+); Deaminating and decarboxylating; one step from anthranilate to catechol.

name: phenol 2-monooxygenase reaction
description: phenol + NADH + O2 + H(+) = catechol + NAD(+) + H2O

name: catechol 1,2-dioxygenase reaction
description: catechol + O2 = cis,cis-muconate + 2 H(+); Intradiol cleavage between the two hydroxyls.

name: muconate cycloisomerase reaction
description: (S)-muconolactone = cis,cis-muconate + H(+); Rhea writes the ring-opening direction; degradation uses it in reverse.

name: muconolactone isomerase reaction
description: (S)-muconolactone = (4,5-dihydro-5-oxofuran-2-yl)-acetate

name: 3-oxoadipate enol-lactonase reaction
description: (4,5-dihydro-5-oxofuran-2-yl)-acetate + H2O = 3-oxoadipate + H(+)

name: 3-oxoadipate CoA-transferase reaction
description: 3-oxoadipate + succinyl-CoA = 3-oxoadipyl-CoA + succinate; Succinyl-CoA is the CoA donor and succinate the co-product; neither is a declared boundary of the GIFT that uses this step.

name: 3-oxoadipyl-CoA thiolase reaction
description: succinyl-CoA + acetyl-CoA = 3-oxoadipyl-CoA + CoA; Rhea writes the condensation direction; degradation uses it in reverse.

name: catechol 2,3-dioxygenase reaction
description: catechol + O2 = (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoate + H(+); Extradiol cleavage adjacent to the hydroxyls.

name: 2-hydroxymuconate semialdehyde hydrolase reaction
description: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoate + H2O = 2-oxopent-4-enoate + formate + H(+)

name: 2-hydroxymuconate semialdehyde dehydrogenase reaction
description: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoate + NAD(+) + H2O = (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxyhexa-2,4-dienedioate + NADH + 2 H(+)

name: 2-hydroxymuconate tautomerase reaction
description: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxyhexa-2,4-dienedioate = (3E)-2-oxohex-3-enedioate

name: 4-oxalocrotonate decarboxylase reaction
description: (3E)-2-oxohex-3-enedioate + H(+) = 2-oxopent-4-enoate + CO2

name: 2-oxopent-4-enoate hydratase reaction
description: (S)-4-hydroxy-2-oxopentanoate = (2Z)-2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate + H2O; Rhea writes the dehydration direction; degradation uses it in reverse. The substrate is the enol tautomer of 2-oxopent-4-enoate.

name: 4-hydroxy-2-oxovalerate aldolase reaction
description: (S)-4-hydroxy-2-oxopentanoate = acetaldehyde + pyruvate

name: phenylacetate-CoA ligase reaction
description: 2-phenylacetate + ATP + CoA = phenylacetyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate

name: phenylacetyl-CoA 1,2-epoxidase reaction
description: phenylacetyl-CoA + NADPH + O2 + H(+) = 2-(1,2-epoxy-1,2-dihydrophenyl)acetyl-CoA + NADP(+) + H2O; Ring activation without dihydroxylation, which is what distinguishes the CoA-dependent aerobic strategy.

name: epoxyphenylacetyl-CoA isomerase reaction
description: 2-(1,2-epoxy-1,2-dihydrophenyl)acetyl-CoA = 2-oxepin-2(3H)-ylideneacetyl-CoA

name: oxepin-CoA hydrolase reaction
description: 2-oxepin-2(3H)-ylideneacetyl-CoA + H2O = 3-oxo-5,6-dehydrosuberyl-CoA semialdehyde; Hydrolytic ring opening; the same PaaZ protein carries the following dehydrogenase step.

name: 3-oxo-5,6-dehydrosuberyl-CoA semialdehyde dehydrogenase reaction
description: 3-oxo-5,6-dehydrosuberyl-CoA semialdehyde + NADP(+) + H2O = 3-oxo-5,6-didehydrosuberyl-CoA + NADPH + 2 H(+)

name: 3-oxo-5,6-didehydrosuberyl-CoA thiolase reaction
description: 2,3-didehydroadipoyl-CoA + acetyl-CoA = 3-oxo-5,6-didehydrosuberyl-CoA + CoA; Rhea writes the condensation direction; degradation uses it in reverse. The same PaaJ thiolase catalyses the terminal thiolysis of the route as well.

name: 2,3-didehydroadipoyl-CoA hydratase reaction
description: (3S)-3-hydroxyadipyl-CoA = (E)-2,3-didehydroadipoyl-CoA + H2O; Rhea writes the dehydration direction; degradation uses it in reverse.

name: 3-hydroxyadipyl-CoA dehydrogenase reaction
description: (3S)-3-hydroxyadipyl-CoA + NAD(+) = 3-oxoadipyl-CoA + NADH + H(+)

name: 3-phenylpropanoate dioxygenase reaction
description: 3-phenylpropanoate + NADH + O2 + H(+) = 3-(cis-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dien-1-yl)propanoate + NAD(+); Rhea gives trans-cinnamate its own master, RHEA:25058, catalysed by the same enzyme. No marker separates the two substrates, so only this one is curated.

name: dihydrodiol dehydrogenase reaction
description: 3-(cis-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dien-1-yl)propanoate + NAD(+) = 3-(2,3-dihydroxyphenyl)propanoate + NADH + H(+)

name: 3-(3-hydroxyphenyl)propanoate hydroxylase reaction
description: 3-(3-hydroxyphenyl)propanoate + NADH + O2 + H(+) = 3-(2,3-dihydroxyphenyl)propanoate + NAD(+) + H2O

name: 2,3-dihydroxyphenylpropanoate 1,2-dioxygenase reaction
description: 3-(2,3-dihydroxyphenyl)propanoate + O2 = (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioate + H(+); Extradiol cleavage of the catecholic phenylpropanoid.

name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxononadienedioate hydrolase reaction
description: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioate + H2O = (2Z)-2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate + succinate + H(+); Releases succinate and the enol tautomer of 2-oxopent-4-enoate.

name: tryptophan synthase reaction
description: Replacement of the glycerol phosphate moiety by L-serine, releasing L-tryptophan. The indole intermediate is channelled between the two subunits and is never free, which is why this GIFT does not connect to the indole anchor.

name: 3-isopropylmalate dehydratase reaction, hydration half
description: Hydration of 2-isopropylmaleate to (2R,3S)-3-isopropylmalate; the second half-reaction of the LeuCD isomerase.

name: argininosuccinate synthase reaction
description: ATP-dependent condensation of L-citrulline with L-aspartate.

name: imidazoleglycerol-phosphate dehydratase reaction
description: Dehydration to imidazole acetol phosphate.

name: aspartate--ammonia ligase reaction
description: ATP-dependent amidation of L-aspartate with ammonium to L-asparagine.

name: anthranilate phosphoribosyltransferase reaction
description: Transfer of the phosphoribosyl group of PRPP to anthranilate; run in the biosynthetic direction here.

name: N-succinyldiaminopimelate aminotransferase reaction
description: Transamination of the succinylated oxo acid to N-succinyl-LL-diaminopimelate.

name: asparagine synthase (glutamine-hydrolysing) reaction
description: ATP-dependent amidation of L-aspartate to L-asparagine using the amide nitrogen of L-glutamine.

name: tetrahydrodipicolinate N-acetyltransferase reaction
description: Acetylation of tetrahydrodipicolinate, opening the acetylated branch to diaminopimelate.

name: ketol-acid reductoisomerase reaction (isoleucine branch)
description: Isomerisation and NADPH-dependent reduction of (S)-2-ethyl-2-hydroxy-3-oxobutanoate to (2R,3R)-2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylpentanoate; run in the reductive direction for biosynthesis.

name: diaminopimelate dehydrogenase reaction
description: Direct reductive amination of the tetrahydrodipicolinate ring-opened oxo acid to meso-diaminopimelate, replacing four steps of the acylated routes with one.

name: prephenate dehydrogenase reaction (NAD)
description: Oxidative decarboxylation of prephenate to 3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvate using NAD.

name: chorismate mutase reaction
description: Claisen rearrangement of chorismate to prephenate, the committed step of both phenylalanine and tyrosine biosynthesis.

name: pyrroline-5-carboxylate reductase reaction
description: Reduction of (S)-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate to L-proline; run in the reductive direction for biosynthesis.

name: histidinol-phosphate phosphatase reaction
description: Dephosphorylation of L-histidinol phosphate to L-histidinol.

name: acetylglutamate kinase reaction
description: Phosphorylation of N-acetyl-L-glutamate.

name: glutamate 5-kinase reaction
description: Phosphorylation of L-glutamate, the committed step of proline biosynthesis.

name: aromatic aminotransferase reaction (tyrosine)
description: Reversible transamination between L-tyrosine and 3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvate; run in the biosynthetic direction here.

name: diaminopimelate decarboxylase reaction
description: Decarboxylation of meso-diaminopimelate to L-lysine, the step that commits the shared peptidoglycan precursor to the amino acid.

name: glutamate N-acetyltransferase reaction
description: Transfer of the acetyl group from N-acetyl-L-ornithine to L-glutamate, releasing L-ornithine and regenerating N-acetyl-L-glutamate. The cyclic route conserves the acetyl group instead of hydrolysing it.

name: diaminopimelate epimerase reaction
description: Epimerisation of LL-diaminopimelate to the meso isomer, which is both the lysine precursor and the peptidoglycan cross-link residue.

name: phosphoribosylformimino-AICAR-phosphate isomerase reaction
description: Amadori rearrangement of the aminoimidazole carboxamide ribotide intermediate.

name: acetylornithine deacetylase reaction
description: Hydrolytic release of L-ornithine and acetate, the linear route ending of ornithine biosynthesis.

name: 3-isopropylmalate dehydratase reaction, dehydration half
description: Dehydration of (2S)-2-isopropylmalate to 2-isopropylmaleate; the first half-reaction of the LeuCD isomerase.

name: tetrahydrodipicolinate N-succinyltransferase reaction
description: Succinylation of tetrahydrodipicolinate, opening the succinylated branch to diaminopimelate.

name: acetylornithine aminotransferase reaction
description: Transamination to N-acetyl-L-ornithine; run in the biosynthetic direction here.

name: branched-chain aminotransferase reaction (leucine)
description: Reversible transamination between L-leucine and 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoate; run in the biosynthetic direction here.

name: alanine dehydrogenase reaction
description: Reductive amination of pyruvate to L-alanine with ammonium; freely reversible and run catabolically in several Firmicutes.

name: ATP phosphoribosyltransferase reaction
description: Condensation of PRPP with ATP to phosphoribosyl-ATP; run in the biosynthetic direction here. The committed and feedback-regulated step of histidine biosynthesis.

name: citramalate synthase reaction
description: Condensation of pyruvate with acetyl-CoA to (3R)-citramalate, the committed step of the threonine-independent isoleucine route.

name: alanine transaminase reaction
description: Reversible transamination between L-alanine and pyruvate; run in the pyruvate-to-alanine direction for biosynthesis.

name: ornithine carbamoyltransferase reaction
description: Carbamoylation of L-ornithine to L-citrulline. Freely reversible: the biosynthetic direction builds citrulline, and the arginine deiminase pathway runs the same enzyme backwards to recover carbamoyl phosphate.

name: glutamate-5-semialdehyde dehydrogenase reaction
description: Reduction of L-glutamyl 5-phosphate to the 5-semialdehyde, which cyclises spontaneously to 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate; run in the reductive direction for biosynthesis.

name: phosphoribosyl-AMP cyclohydrolase reaction
description: Ring opening of phosphoribosyl-AMP.

name: N-acetyldiaminopimelate deacetylase reaction
description: Hydrolytic removal of the acetyl group, releasing LL-diaminopimelate.

name: 2-isopropylmalate synthase reaction
description: Condensation of 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate with acetyl-CoA, the committed step of leucine biosynthesis.

name: phosphoribosylanthranilate isomerase reaction
description: Amadori rearrangement of phosphoribosylanthranilate.

name: N-acetyl-gamma-glutamyl-phosphate reductase reaction
description: Reduction to N-acetyl-L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde; run in the reductive direction for biosynthesis.

name: prephenate dehydrogenase reaction (NADP)
description: Oxidative decarboxylation of prephenate to 3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvate using NADP.

name: prephenate dehydratase reaction
description: Decarboxylative dehydration of prephenate to 3-phenylpyruvate.

name: anthranilate synthase reaction
description: Amination and aromatisation of chorismate to anthranilate using the amide nitrogen of L-glutamine. KEGG also lists an ammonia-dependent partial reaction for the same enzyme; as with the glutamine-dependent GMP synthase already curated, only the complete glutamine-dependent chemistry is used.

name: aspartate aminotransferase reaction
description: Reversible transamination between L-aspartate and oxaloacetate; run in the oxaloacetate-to-aspartate direction for biosynthesis.

name: ketol-acid reductoisomerase reaction (valine branch)
description: Isomerisation and NADPH-dependent reduction of (2S)-2-acetolactate to (2R)-2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylbutanoate; run in the reductive direction for biosynthesis.

name: 2-methylmalate dehydratase reaction, dehydration half
description: Dehydration of (3R)-citramalate to 2-methylmaleate, catalysed by the isopropylmalate isomerase acting on the citramalate substrate.

name: succinyl-diaminopimelate desuccinylase reaction
description: Hydrolytic removal of the succinyl group, releasing LL-diaminopimelate.

name: phosphoribosyl-ATP pyrophosphohydrolase reaction
description: Hydrolysis of the pyrophosphate of phosphoribosyl-ATP.

name: indole-3-glycerol-phosphate synthase reaction
description: Ring closure to (1S,2R)-1-C-(indol-3-yl)glycerol 3-phosphate, which builds the indole ring.

name: histidinol-phosphate aminotransferase reaction
description: Transamination of imidazole acetol phosphate to L-histidinol phosphate; run in the biosynthetic direction here.

name: LL-diaminopimelate aminotransferase reaction
description: Single-step transamination of tetrahydrodipicolinate to LL-diaminopimelate, the plant and Chlamydia route.

name: argininosuccinate lyase reaction
description: Elimination of fumarate, releasing L-arginine.

name: amino-acid N-acetyltransferase reaction
description: Acetylation of L-glutamate, which protects the amino group through the ornithine branch.

name: imidazole glycerol-phosphate synthase reaction
description: Glutamine-dependent cyclisation to imidazole glycerol phosphate, releasing AICAR into purine metabolism. AICAR is not declared as an anchor: it is an internal participant of the purine GIFT and declaring it would create an edge nobody would read as biology.

name: branched-chain aminotransferase reaction (isoleucine)
description: Reversible transamination between L-isoleucine and (S)-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate; run in the biosynthetic direction here.

name: dihydroxy-acid dehydratase reaction (valine branch)
description: Dehydration of (2R)-2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylbutanoate to 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate, the branchpoint 2-oxo acid shared with pantothenate biosynthesis.

name: branched-chain aminotransferase reaction (valine)
description: Reversible transamination between L-valine and 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate; run in the biosynthetic direction here. The same enzyme catalyses the leucine and isoleucine transaminations, which is why the discriminating evidence for each amino acid is its 2-oxo acid supply rather than this step.

name: aromatic aminotransferase reaction (phenylalanine)
description: Reversible transamination between L-phenylalanine and 3-phenylpyruvate; run in the biosynthetic direction here.

name: N-acetyldiaminopimelate aminotransferase reaction
description: Transamination of the acetylated oxo acid to N-acetyl-LL-diaminopimelate.

name: acetohydroxyacid synthase reaction (isoleucine branch)
description: Condensation of 2-oxobutanoate with pyruvate to (S)-2-ethyl-2-hydroxy-3-oxobutanoate, the isoleucine-specific reaction of the same acetohydroxyacid synthase that condenses two pyruvates in the valine branch.

name: dihydroxy-acid dehydratase reaction (isoleucine branch)
description: Dehydration of (2R,3R)-2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylpentanoate to (S)-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate.

name: 3-isopropylmalate dehydrogenase reaction
description: Oxidative decarboxylation of (2R,3S)-3-isopropylmalate to 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoate. Rhea states the overall reaction, so the spontaneous decarboxylation of the oxosuccinate intermediate is inside it.

name: 3-methylmalate dehydrogenase reaction
description: Oxidative decarboxylation of (2R,3S)-3-methylmalate to 2-oxobutanoate, catalysed by the isopropylmalate dehydrogenase.

name: histidinol dehydrogenase reaction, first oxidation
description: NAD-dependent oxidation of L-histidinol to L-histidinal.

name: histidinol dehydrogenase reaction, second oxidation
description: NAD-dependent oxidation of L-histidinal to L-histidine.

name: 4-hydroxy-tetrahydrodipicolinate synthase reaction
description: Condensation of L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde with pyruvate, the committed step of the diaminopimelate pathway.

name: 4-hydroxy-tetrahydrodipicolinate reductase reaction (NADPH)
description: Reduction and dehydration of (2S,4S)-4-hydroxy-tetrahydrodipicolinate to tetrahydrodipicolinate. The NADH-linked variant RHEA:35323 is the same enzyme with the same orthology group, so it is not curated as a separate route: it would multiply the four diaminopimelate routes without adding any genomic discrimination.

name: 2-methylmalate dehydratase reaction, hydration half
description: Hydration of 2-methylmaleate to (2R,3S)-3-methylmalate.

name: carbamate kinase reaction
description: Interconversion of carbamoyl phosphate with ammonium and hydrogencarbonate; run in the phosphate-donating direction by the arginine deiminase pathway, where it is the substrate-level ATP-generating step.

name: proline racemase reaction
description: Racemisation of L-proline to D-proline, which is the substrate the proline reductase requires.

name: glycine reductase reaction
description: Reductive deamination of glycine to acetyl phosphate and ammonium by the selenoprotein glycine reductase complex; run in the glycine-consuming direction, which is the Stickland reductive half-reaction.

name: D-proline reductase reaction
description: Reductive ring opening of D-proline to 5-aminopentanoate by the selenoprotein proline reductase; run in the proline-consuming direction, which is the Stickland reductive half-reaction.

name: urocanate hydratase reaction
description: Hydration of trans-urocanate to 4-imidazolone-5-propanoate; run in the hydration direction for catabolism.

name: glutamate decarboxylase reaction
description: PLP-dependent decarboxylation of L-glutamate to 4-aminobutanoate, consuming a cytoplasmic proton. The reaction is the core of the glutamate-dependent acid resistance system and the source of microbial GABA.

name: serine ammonia-lyase reaction
description: PLP- or iron-sulfur-dependent deamination of L-serine to pyruvate and ammonium, the step that makes serine a fermentable substrate rather than only a biosynthetic product.

name: tryptophanase reaction
description: Beta-elimination of L-tryptophan to indole, pyruvate and ammonium. One PLP enzyme, one orthology group, and the basis of the classical clinical indole test.

name: arginine deiminase reaction
description: Hydrolytic deimination of L-arginine to L-citrulline and ammonium, the committed step of the arginine deiminase pathway.

name: histidine ammonia-lyase reaction
description: Non-oxidative deamination of L-histidine to trans-urocanate, the committed step of histidine catabolism.

name: threonine ammonia-lyase reaction
description: PLP-dependent deamination of L-threonine to 2-oxobutanoate and ammonium. The chemistry is catabolic wherever it runs; the product is also the precursor isoleucine biosynthesis requires, which is why the two capabilities compose across modes rather than duplicating the reaction.

name: formimidoylglutamase reaction
description: Hydrolysis of N-formimidoyl-L-glutamate to formamide and L-glutamate, the route that releases the carbon skeleton without a folate-dependent transfer.

name: imidazolonepropionase reaction
description: Ring hydrolysis to N-formimidoyl-L-glutamate.

name: methionine gamma-lyase reaction
description: Gamma-elimination of L-methionine to methanethiol, 2-oxobutanoate and ammonium. The enzyme also accepts homocysteine and cysteine; the GIFT is named for methionine and this marker is deliberately not used as evidence for any cysteine trait.

name: cysteine desulfidase reaction
description: Beta-elimination of L-cysteine to hydrogen sulfide, pyruvate and ammonium. Rhea files the same equation under the promiscuous cystathionine gamma-lyase, which is why only the dedicated desulfidase orthology groups are accepted as evidence here.
